newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Seagate rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Seagate rating cut.

text.p: -- Robertson Stephens and Co analyst Jon van Bronkhorst said he cut his rating on shares of disk driver maker Seagate Technology Inc to long-term attractive from buy.
-- He cut his 1997 earnings estimate to $5.47 from $5.95.

-- In a written statement, van Bronkhorst said "it appears that earnings growth opportunities are slowing." He added unit sales growth will remain health "although most of it will come at the low end of the product spectrum."
-- Thursday Seagate reported third quarter earnings of $1.06 a share versus $1.05 one year ago.
